BiblicalUsage: Kartan is a city of refuge in Naphtali. It was given to the Gershonites with Hammoth-dor, one of the three cities of that tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the city of refuge as God's mercy built into the map, a place to run to before the avenger comes.
